attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Ground-level public space geometry recovered from the project's 13.10.2026 OSM snapshots.
coverage: Mapped areas within 250 m, walking paths within 180 m, furniture within 140 m of line 22. Coordinates have not been simplified or moved.
limitations: OSM surface and width tags are retained where available. Missing dimensions, pavement patterns and furniture mesh shapes are visual estimates.
Indoor/private circulation, steps and bridge/tunnel paths are omitted. Runtime terrain interpolation is approximate.
Only complete multipolygon rings are retained; inner islands and courtyards remain holes.
